title: Create a consistent character reference first by generating a 16:9 anime…
content:
Create a consistent character reference first by generating a 16:9 anime “character design sheet/model sheet” (front/side/back turnarounds + close-ups + color swatches) in GPT Image 2.0, then use that as the basis for your Seedance 2.5 animation.

Use Fable 5.1 to generate the story and the final video prompt text, then run that prompt through Renoise CLI targeting Seedance 2.5 to produce the animation.

Crea primero una referencia consistente del personaje generando una “character design sheet/model sheet” anime en 16:9 (turnarounds frontal/lateral/trasera + close-ups + muestras de color) en GPT Image 2.0, y luego úsala como base para tu animación en Seedance 2.5.

Usa Fable 5.1 para generar la historia y el texto final del prompt de video, luego ejecuta ese prompt a través de Renoise CLI apuntando a Seedance 2.5 para producir la animación.

Fable 5.1 vs Kimi K3 — prueba de escena anime

Ambos fueron hechos con Renoise CLI. ¿Cuál resultado te gusta más?

Prompt en el hilo 🧵 https://t.co/9kY7voys8N

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] 1️⃣character sheet:

Create a polished 16:9 professional anime character design sheet for an original next-generation battle android named “MIRAGE”, presented as a premium Japanese sci-fi action game production model sheet. Clean warm-white background, minimal thin gray divider lines, spacious editorial layout, precise technical presentation, no environment or decorative clutter.

CHARACTER: A beautiful young female combat android with a tall elegant athletic silhouette, pale skin, sharp golden-amber eyes and a calm, cold, highly controlled expression. Her design combines sleek feminine proportions with sophisticated mechanical armor. She has very long silver-white hair gathered into a high flowing ponytail, with layered bangs framing the face. Two tall angular mechanical fox-ear sensor units rise from both sides of her head, built from white armor shells, exposed black mechanisms and small amber-gold illuminated components.

ARMOR DESIGN: Her entire body is covered by a highly articulated white, black and amber-gold biomechanical combat suit. The main armor is glossy pearl white with deep matte-black mechanical joints, exposed segmented structures and restrained metallic gold-orange accents. The armor follows the natural anatomy closely while remaining clearly mechanical.

The torso features a smooth sculpted white armored chest and abdomen with layered interlocking plates. Thin black mechanical seams divide the armor sections, while small circular amber energy nodes appear around the collar, ribs and waist. The shoulder armor is compact and angular rather than bulky, revealing complex black rotary joints beneath. Arms use segmented white forearm shells, black articulated elbows and mechanical fingers with sharp claw-like fingertips.

The hips use compact floating armor plates with gold-edged tips. Legs are long and heavily engineered, with white thigh armor, exposed black knee mechanisms, circular amber joints and tapered shin armor. The feet form elegant mechanical high-heel combat boots with narrow gold heels, reinforced toes and black articulated ankle assemblies.

HEAD DESIGN: Silver-white hair, golden eyes and a refined anime face contrast with the hard mechanical armor. The mechanical fox-ear sensors have sharp triangular silhouettes with dark internal structures and small gold illumination. Additional compact black-and-white machinery wraps around the sides of her head and neck without obscuring her face.

WEAPON: MIRAGE carries two enormous matching crescent-shaped transforming combat blades, one for each hand. Each weapon has a sweeping curved silhouette resembling a futuristic mechanical scythe or crescent claw. Pearl-white outer armor surrounds exposed black internal machinery, circular rotary mechanisms and glowing amber energy cores. The cutting edges are metallic gold-orange. The weapons should look heavy, advanced and mechanically functional, with visible pivots, layered blade segments and articulated internal components. Both weapons must remain identical in construction and scale.

TURNAROUND: The left and center of the sheet contain three large full-body orthographic views labeled FRONT, SIDE and BACK. Front view clearly displays her facial design, mechanical fox ears, chest armor, waist construction, leg articulation and both crescent weapons. Side view emphasizes the high ponytail, curved spinal armor, mechanical joints, weapon thickness and high-heel foot structure. Back view clearly reveals the ponytail attachment, rear torso mechanics, spine and hip armor, rear leg engineering and weapon silhouettes. Maintain exactly the same anatomy, armor components, color placement and weapon design across every view.

DETAILS: Upper-right contains four clean rectangular close-up studies. One shows the face, mechanical fox ears, hair roots and neck machinery. One shows the shoulder and upper-arm rotary mechanism. One shows the torso and waist articulation with overlapping white armor plates and amber energy nodes. One shows the mechanical high-heel boot, ankle joint and lower-leg construction.

WEAPON DISPLAY: Below the details panel, show the complete crescent weapon horizontally at large scale, followed by two smaller technical studies showing alternate viewing angles and mechanical construction. Preserve the same white, black and amber-gold design language. Clearly expose circular pivots, internal black framework, blade segmentation and gold cutting edges.

COLOR SCHEME: Bottom-right displays three minimal square swatches: pearl white, charcoal black and warm amber-gold.

GRAPHIC DESIGN: Large minimalist title “MIRAGE” in the upper-left with smaller subtitle “NEXT-GEN BATTLE DOLL”. Small technical labels such as FRONT, SIDE, BACK, DETAILS, WEAPON and COLOR SCHEME. Bottom-right contains a tiny stylized angular fox-head project emblem with the designation “NX-07” and small “PROJECT MIRAGE” text. Typography is clean modern sans-serif with wide spacing.

VISUAL STYLE: premium Japanese sci-fi anime concept art, next-generation battle android, elegant mecha musume design, extremely refined hard-surface mechanical detailing, crisp precise linework, polished cel shading with subtle semi-realistic rendering, pearl-white ceramic armor, matte-black machinery, restrained amber metallic accents, complex functional joints, sophisticated industrial design, elegant feminine silhouette, professional game production character bible, highly consistent orthographic turnaround, production-ready model sheet, ultra detailed.

Avoid bulky power armor, medieval armor, exposed human clothing, skirts, fabric costumes, excessive gold decoration, colorful neon accents, giant shoulder pads, wings, firearms, fantasy magic, animal tail, extra weapons, different armor between views, inconsistent weapon geometry, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, photorealism, background scenery, excessive text, watermark.

[Hilo 2] 2️⃣video prompt: https://t.co/ANkmd3OAg6

まず、GPT Image 2.0で16:9のアニメ「character design sheet / model sheet」（正面・側面・背面のターンアラウンド＋クローズアップ＋カラースウォッチ）を生成して、一貫したキャラクター参照を作成し、それをSeedance 2.5アニメーションのベースとして使用します。

Fable 5.1でストーリーと最終的な動画用プロンプト文を生成し、そのプロンプトをRenoise CLIでSeedance 2.5向けに実行してアニメーションを生成します。

Fable 5.1 vs Kimi K3 — anime scene test 

どちらの出力がより好みですか？

スレッド内のプロンプト 🧵 https://t.co/9kY7voys8N

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 1️⃣character sheet:

洗練された16:9のプロフェッショナルなアニメキャラクターデザインシートを作成してください。オリジナルの次世代戦闘アンドロイド「MIRAGE」を、プレミアムな日本のSFアクションゲーム用プロダクションモデルシートとして提示します。背景はクリーンな温かみのある白、細いグレーの区切り線、余白を活かしたエディトリアルなレイアウト、正確な技術的プレゼンテーション。環境要素や装飾的な雑多さは一切不要です。

CHARACTER: 美しい若い女性型戦闘アンドロイド。背が高くエレガントでアスレチックなシルエット、淡い肌、鋭いゴールデンアンバーの瞳、落ち着いた冷たい高度に制御された表情。デザインは、洗練された女性的プロポーションと高度な機械装甲を融合させています。非常に長い銀白色の髪を高く流れるようなポニーテールにまとめ、レイヤーの入った前髪が顔を縁取っています。頭の両側からは、白いアーマーシェル、露出した黒い機構、小さなアンバーゴールドの発光パーツで構成された、背の高い角張った機械式の狐耳センサーユニットが立ち上がっています。

ARMOR DESIGN: 彼女の全身は、高度に可動する白・黒・アンバーゴールドのバイオメカニカル戦闘スーツで覆われています。メインアーマーは光沢のあるパールホワイトで、深いマットブラックの機械関節、露出した分節構造、抑制されたメタリックなゴールドオレンジのアクセントを備えています。アーマーは自然な解剖学に密接に沿いながらも、明確に機械的であることが分かるデザインです。

胴体は、滑らかに造形された白い装甲の胸部と腹部で構成され、層状に重なり合うインターロッキングプレートが配置されています。細い黒い機械シームがアーマーの各セクションを分け、首元、肋骨、腰の周囲には小さな円形のアンバーエネルギーノードが見えます。肩アーマーは大型でなくコンパクトかつ角張っており、その下に複雑な黒い回転関節が覗いています。腕は分節化された白い前腕シェル、黒い可動式の肘、鋭い爪のような先端を持つ機械指で構成されています。

腰部には、ゴールドの縁取りを持つコンパクトなフローティングアーマープレートを使用。脚は長く高度に設計され、白い大腿部アーマー、露出した黒い膝機構、円形のアンバー関節、先細りの脛アーマーを備えています。足は、細いゴールドのヒール、補強されたつま先、黒い可動式足首アセンブリを持つ、エレガントな機械式ハイヒール戦闘ブーツになっています。

HEAD DESIGN: 銀白色の髪、ゴールデンの瞳、洗練されたアニメ顔が、硬質な機械装甲と対比を成しています。機械式の狐耳センサーは、鋭い三角形のシルエット、暗い内部構造、小さなゴールドの発光を備えています。さらに、コンパクトな黒と白の機械パーツが顔を隠さないようにしながら、頭部と首の側面を包み込んでいます。

WEAPON: MIRAGEは、左右それぞれの手に対応する2本の巨大な、同一形状の三日月型変形戦闘ブレードを携えています。各武器は、未来的な機械式の鎌または三日月の爪を思わせる、大きく弧を描くシルエットを持っています。パールホワイトの外装アーマーが、露出した黒い内部機構、円形の回転機構、発光するアンバーのエネルギーコアを囲んでいます。刃先はメタリックなゴールドオレンジです。武器は重厚で先進的、かつ機械的に機能するように見え、可視のピボット、層状のブレードセグメント、可動式の内部コンポーネントを備えている必要があります。両武器は構造とスケールが完全に同一でなければなりません。

TURNAROUND: シートの左側と中央には、FRONT、SIDE、BACKとラベル付けされた3つの大きな全身正投影ビューを配置します。正面図では、顔のデザイン、機械式の狐耳、胸部アーマー、腰の構造、脚の可動部、そして両方の三日月武器が明確に見えるようにします。側面図では、高いポニーテール、湾曲した背骨のアーマー、機械関節、武器の厚み、ハイヒールの足部構造を強調します。背面図では、ポニーテールの取り付け部、背面胴体の機構、背骨と腰のアーマー、脚の後部構造、武器のシルエットがはっきり分かるようにします。すべてのビューで、解剖学、アーマー構成、配色、武器デザインを完全に同一に保ってください。

DETAILS: 右上には、4つのクリーンな長方形のクローズアップ अध्ययनを配置します。1つは顔、機械式の狐耳、髪の根元、首の機構を示します。1つは肩と上腕の回転機構を示します。1つは、重なり合う白いアーマープレートとアンバーのエネルギーノードを伴う胴体と腰の可動部を示します。1つは、機械式ハイヒールブーツ、足首関節、下腿構造を示します。

WEAPON DISPLAY: 詳細パネルの下には、完全な三日月武器を大きなスケールで横向きに表示し、その後に、別角度からの見え方と機械構造を示す2つの小さな技術的スタディを続けて配置します。白・黒・アンバーゴールドのデザイン言語を維持してください。円形ピボット、内部の黒いフレームワーク、刃の分節構造、ゴールドの切断エッジを明確に露出させてください。

COLOR SCHEME: 右下には、パールホワイト、チャコールブラック、ウォームアンバーゴールドの3つのミニマルな正方形スウォッチを表示します。

GRAPHIC DESIGN: 左上に大きくミニマルなタイトル「MIRAGE」、その下に小さめのサブタイトル「NEXT-GEN BATTLE DOLL」。FRONT、SIDE、BACK、DETAILS、WEAPON、COLOR SCHEMEなどの小さな技術ラベル。右下には、細いスタイライズされた角張

--- 인용된 트윗 ---
Fable 5.1 vs Kimi K3 — anime scene test 

둘 다 Renoise CLI로 만들었습니다. 어떤 결과가 더 마음에 드시나요?

스레드의 프롬프트 🧵 https://t.co/9kY7voys8N

--- 스레드 계속 ---
[Thread 1] 1️⃣character sheet:

원본 차세대 배틀 안드로이드 “MIRAGE”를 위한 세련된 16:9 프로페셔널 애니메이션 캐릭터 디자인 시트를 제작하세요. 프리미엄 일본 SF 액션 게임 제작용 모델 시트 스타일로 표현합니다. 깨끗한 따뜻한 흰색 배경, 최소한의 얇은 회색 구분선, 여유 있는 편집 레이아웃, 정밀한 기술적 प्रस्त현, 환경이나 장식적 잡동사니 없음.

CHARACTER: 키가 크고 우아한 운동형 실루엣을 가진 아름다운 젊은 여성 전투 안드로이드. 창백한 피부, 날카로운 황금빛 호박색 눈, 차분하고 차갑고 매우 통제된 표정. 디자인은 세련된 여성적 비율과 정교한 기계식 아머를 결합한다. 매우 긴 은백색 머리를 높게 묶은 흐르는 포니테일로 연출하고, 층진 앞머리가 얼굴을 감싼다. 머리 양쪽에는 흰색 아머 셸, 노출된 검은 메커니즘, 작은 호박빛 발광 부품으로 구성된, 키가 크고 각진 기계식 여우 귀 센서 유닛 두 개가 솟아 있다.

ARMOR DESIGN: 전신은 정교하게 관절화된 흰색, 검은색, 호박빛 금색의 바이오메카닉 전투 슈트로 덮여 있다. 메인 아머는 광택 있는 펄 화이트이며, 짙은 무광 블랙 기계 관절, 노출된 분절 구조, 절제된 메탈릭 골드-오렌지 포인트가 있다. 아머는 자연스러운 해부학을 밀착해 따르면서도 분명히 기계적인 느낌을 유지한다.

상체는 매끈하게 조형된 흰색 아머드 가슴과 복부, 그리고 겹겹이 맞물리는 플레이트로 구성된다. 얇은 검은 기계식 이음새가 아머 구획을 나누고, 작은 원형 호박빛 에너지 노드가 목선, 갈비뼈, 허리 주변에 배치된다. 어깨 아머는 부피감이 큰 대신 작고 각진 형태이며, 그 아래의 복잡한 검은 회전 관절이 드러난다. 팔은 분절된 흰색 전완 셸, 검은 관절형 팔꿈치, 날카로운 발톱 같은 끝을 가진 기계 손가락으로 구성된다.

엉덩이에는 금색 테두리의 끝이 달린 컴팩트한 플로팅 아머 플레이트를 사용한다. 다리는 길고 고도로 엔지니어링되어 있으며, 흰색 허벅지 아머, 노출된 검은 무릎 메커니즘, 원형 호박빛 관절, 끝이 가늘어진 정강이 아머로 이루어진다. 발은 좁은 금색 힐, 보강된 발끝, 검은 관절형 발목 어셈블리를 갖춘 우아한 기계식 하이힐 전투 부츠 형태다.

HEAD DESIGN: 은백색 머리카락, 황금빛 눈, 세련된 애니메이션 얼굴이 단단한 기계식 아머와 대비된다. 기계식 여우 귀 센서는 어두운 내부 구조와 작은 금빛 발광을 지닌 날카로운 삼각 실루엣이다. 얼굴을 가리지 않으면서 머리와 목 옆을 감싸는 추가적인 컴팩트한 흑백 기계 장치가 있다.

WEAPON: MIRAGE는 양손에 하나씩, 서로 짝을 이루는 거대한 초승달 형태의 변형 전투 블레이드 두 자루를 든다. 각 무기는 미래적인 기계식 낫 또는 초승달 발톱을 연상시키는 넓게 휘어진 실루엣을 가진다. 펄 화이트 외부 아머가 노출된 검은 내부 메커니즘, 원형 회전 장치, 발광하는 호박빛 에너지 코어를 감싼다. 절단 날은 메탈릭 골드-오렌지 색이다. 무기는 무겁고, 첨단이며, 기계적으로 기능하는 느낌이어야 하고, 보이는 피벗, 겹겹의 블레이드 분절, 관절형 내부 부품이 드러나야 한다. 두 무기는 구조와 규모가 완전히 동일해야 한다.

TURNAROUND: 시트의 왼쪽과 중앙에는 FRONT, SIDE, BACK으로 라벨링된 세 개의 큰 전신 정투영 뷰를 배치한다. 정면 뷰는 얼굴 디자인, 기계식 여우 귀, 가슴 아머, 허리 구조, 다리 관절, 양쪽 초승달 무기를 명확히 보여준다. 측면 뷰는 높은 포니테일, 곡선형 척추 아머, 기계 관절, 무기의 두께, 하이힐 발 구조를 강조한다. 후면 뷰는 포니테일 부착부, 후면 상체 메커니즘, 척추와 엉덩이 아머, 후면 다리 구조, 무기 실루엣을 명확히 드러낸다. 모든 뷰에서 해부학, 아머 구성 요소, 색상 배치, 무기 디자인이 정확히 동일하게 유지되어야 한다.

DETAILS: 오른쪽 상단에는 깔끔한 직사각형 클로즈업 연구 4개를 배치한다. 하나는 얼굴, 기계식 여우 귀, 머리카락 뿌리, 목 메커니즘을 보여준다. 하나는 어깨와 상완의 회전 메커니즘을 보여준다. 하나는 겹쳐진 흰색 아머 플레이트와 호박빛 에너지 노드가 있는 상체와 허리 관절 구조를 보여준다. 하나는 기계식 하이힐 부츠, 발목 관절, 하퇴부 구조를 보여준다.

WEAPON DISPLAY: 디테일 패널 아래에는 완전한 초승달 무기를 큰 스케일로 가로 방향으로 보여주고, 이어서 다른 시점과 기계적 구조를 보여주는 더 작은 기술 연구 2개를 배치한다. 동일한 흰색, 검은색, 호박빛 금색 디자인 언어를 유지한다. 원형 피벗, 내부 검은 프레임워크, 블레이드 분절, 금색 절단 날을 명확히 드러낸다.

COLOR SCHEME: 오른쪽 하단에는 펄 화이트, 차콜 블랙, 웜 앰버-골드의 미니멀한 정사각형 스와치 3개를 표시한다.

GRAPHIC DESIGN: 왼쪽 상단에 큰 미니멀리스트 타이틀 “MIRAGE”, 그 아래 작은 부제 “NEXT-GEN BATTLE DOLL”. FRONT, SIDE, BACK, DETAILS, WEAPON, COLOR SCHEME 같은 작은 기술 라벨. 오른쪽 하단에는 작은 스타일화된 각진 여우 머리 프로젝트 엠블럼과 “NX-07” 표기, 그리고 작은 “PROJECT MIRAGE” 텍스트가 있다. 타이포그래피는 넓은 자간의 깔끔한 모던 산세리프다.

VISUAL STYLE: 프리미엄 일본 SF 애니메이션 콘셉트 아트, 차세대 배틀 안드로이드, 우아한 메카 무스메 디자인, 극도로 정교한 하드서피스 기계 디테일, 선명하고 정확한 라인워크, 미묘한 شبه사실적 렌더링이 섞인 세련된 셀 셰이딩, 펄 화이트 세라믹 아머, 무광 블랙 메커니즘, 절제된 앰버

Crie primeiro uma referência consistente do personagem gerando uma “character design sheet/model sheet” anime em 16:9 (turnarounds de frente/lado/costas + close-ups + amostras de cor) no GPT Image 2.0, e então use isso como base para sua animação no Seedance 2.5.

Use o Fable 5.1 para gerar a história e o texto final do prompt de vídeo, depois execute esse prompt pelo Renoise CLI direcionando para o Seedance 2.5 para produzir a animação.

--- TWEET CITADO ---
Fable 5.1 vs Kimi K3 — teste de cena anime

Ambos foram feitos com o Renoise CLI. Qual resultado você prefere?

Prompt no thread 🧵 https://t.co/9kY7voys8N

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO THREAD ---
[Thread 1] 1️⃣character sheet:

Create a polished 16:9 professional anime character design sheet for an original next-generation battle android named “MIRAGE”, presented as a premium Japanese sci-fi action game production model sheet. Clean warm-white background, minimal thin gray divider lines, spacious editorial layout, precise technical presentation, no environment or decorative clutter.

CHARACTER: A beautiful young female combat android with a tall elegant athletic silhouette, pale skin, sharp golden-amber eyes and a calm, cold, highly controlled expression. Her design combines sleek feminine proportions with sophisticated mechanical armor. She has very long silver-white hair gathered into a high flowing ponytail, with layered bangs framing the face. Two tall angular mechanical fox-ear sensor units rise from both sides of her head, built from white armor shells, exposed black mechanisms and small amber-gold illuminated components.

ARMOR DESIGN: Her entire body is covered by a highly articulated white, black and amber-gold biomechanical combat suit. The main armor is glossy pearl white with deep matte-black mechanical joints, exposed segmented structures and restrained metallic gold-orange accents. The armor follows the natural anatomy closely while remaining clearly mechanical.

The torso features a smooth sculpted white armored chest and abdomen with layered interlocking plates. Thin black mechanical seams divide the armor sections, while small circular amber energy nodes appear around the collar, ribs and waist. The shoulder armor is compact and angular rather than bulky, revealing complex black rotary joints beneath. Arms use segmented white forearm shells, black articulated elbows and mechanical fingers with sharp claw-like fingertips.

The hips use compact floating armor plates with gold-edged tips. Legs are long and heavily engineered, with white thigh armor, exposed black knee mechanisms, circular amber joints and tapered shin armor. The feet form elegant mechanical high-heel combat boots with narrow gold heels, reinforced toes and black articulated ankle assemblies.

HEAD DESIGN: Silver-white hair, golden eyes and a refined anime face contrast with the hard mechanical armor. The mechanical fox-ear sensors have sharp triangular silhouettes with dark internal structures and small gold illumination. Additional compact black-and-white machinery wraps around the sides of her head and neck without obscuring her face.

WEAPON: MIRAGE carries two enormous matching crescent-shaped transforming combat blades, one for each hand. Each weapon has a sweeping curved silhouette resembling a futuristic mechanical scythe or crescent claw. Pearl-white outer armor surrounds exposed black internal machinery, circular rotary mechanisms and glowing amber energy cores. The cutting edges are metallic gold-orange. The weapons should look heavy, advanced and mechanically functional, with visible pivots, layered blade segments and articulated internal components. Both weapons must remain identical in construction and scale.

TURNAROUND: The left and center of the sheet contain three large full-body orthographic views labeled FRONT, SIDE and BACK. Front view clearly displays her facial design, mechanical fox ears, chest armor, waist construction, leg articulation and both crescent weapons. Side view emphasizes the high ponytail, curved spinal armor, mechanical joints, weapon thickness and high-heel foot structure. Back view clearly reveals the ponytail attachment, rear torso mechanics, spine and hip armor, rear leg engineering and weapon silhouettes. Maintain exactly the same anatomy, armor components, color placement and weapon design across every view.

DETAILS: Upper-right contains four clean rectangular close-up studies. One shows the face, mechanical fox ears, hair roots and neck machinery. One shows the shoulder and upper-arm rotary mechanism. One shows the torso and waist articulation with overlapping white armor plates and amber energy nodes. One shows the mechanical high-heel boot, ankle joint and lower-leg construction.

WEAPON DISPLAY: Below the details panel, show the complete crescent weapon horizontally at large scale, followed by two smaller technical studies showing alternate viewing angles and mechanical construction. Preserve the same white, black and amber-gold design language. Clearly expose circular pivots, internal black framework, blade segmentation and gold cutting edges.

COLOR SCHEME: Bottom-right displays three minimal square swatches: pearl white, charcoal black and warm amber-gold.

GRAPHIC DESIGN: Large minimalist title “MIRAGE” in the upper-left with smaller subtitle “NEXT-GEN BATTLE DOLL”. Small technical labels such as FRONT, SIDE, BACK, DETAILS, WEAPON and COLOR SCHEME. Bottom-right contains a tiny stylized angular fox-head project emblem with the designation “NX-07” and small “PROJECT MIRAGE” text. Typography is clean modern sans-serif with wide spacing.

VISUAL STYLE: premium Japanese sci-fi anime concept art, next-generation battle android, elegant mecha musume design, extremely refined hard-surface mechanical detailing, crisp precise linework, polished cel shading with subtle semi-realistic rendering, pearl-white ceramic armor, matte-black machinery, restrained amber metallic accents, complex functional joints, sophisticated industrial design, elegant feminine silhouette, professional game production character bible, highly consistent orthographic turnaround, production-ready model sheet, ultra detailed.

Avoid bulky power armor, medieval armor, exposed human clothing, skirts, fabric costumes, excessive gold decoration, colorful neon accents, giant shoulder pads, wings, firearms, fantasy magic, animal tail, extra weapons, different armor between views, inconsistent weapon geometry, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, photorealism, background scenery, excessive text, watermark.

[Thread 2] 2️⃣video prompt: https://t.co/ANkmd3OAg6
